Hina.description: anime girl Hina, 12 years old, long wavy black hair with a white tiare flower behind her ear, warm brown skin, big expressive dark eyes, turquoise pareo dress, glowing seashell necklace

L'Esprit de la Tempête.description: colossal storm spirit made of swirling dark clouds and lightning, two glowing violet eyes, towering over the ocean

scenes.image: aerial view of a tiny lush tropical volcanic island surrounded by a glowing turquoise lagoon at dusk, pink and orange sky, first stars
scenes.texte: Sur une île perdue au milieu du Pacifique…

scenes.image: {Hina} standing barefoot on a white sand beach at sunset, talking to the gentle waves, palm trees, warm golden light, wide shot
scenes.texte: vivait Hina, une jeune fille qui savait parler à l'océan.

scenes.image: close-up portrait of {Hina} holding a glowing turquoise seashell in her hands, light reflecting on her face, worried expression, night beach
scenes.texte: Grand-mère disait que ce coquillage protège notre lagon… Mais pourquoi brille-t-il ce soir ?

scenes.image: massive dark storm clouds rolling over a turquoise ocean at night, violet lightning striking the sea, huge waves, dramatic wide shot
{L'Esprit de la Tempête} looming above a small tropical island at night, menacing, low angle shot
scenes.texte: Petite humaine… Ce lagon m'appartient désormais !

scenes.image: {Hina} standing on a black lava rock facing a raging storm, hair and pareo blowing in the wind, determined fierce expression, low angle hero shot
scenes.texte: Non ! Ce lagon est notre maison. Je ne te laisserai pas faire !

scenes.image: {Hina} raising a glowing seashell to the sky, a huge beam of turquoise light bursting upward into the storm clouds, spirits of ancestors made of light, epic magical moment
scenes.texte: Hina leva le coquillage vers le ciel… et la lumière de ses ancêtres jaillit.

scenes.image: {L'Esprit de la Tempête} dissolving into turquoise light particles, clouds breaking apart, rays of light, dramatic
{Hina} smiling peacefully on the beach at sunrise, calm crystal clear turquoise lagoon, rainbow in the sky, hopeful atmosphere
scenes.texte: Le calme revint sur le lagon. Et depuis ce jour, tout le monde l'appelle : la Gardienne du Lagon.

scenes.image: a glowing turquoise seashell resting on white sand at night under a sky full of stars, waves gently touching it
